rfp_requirements.title: Notify Employer of new classification assignment contention
rfp_requirements.description: Within 30 days of notification of any newly created classification, the Union shall notify the Employer in writing if it contends the new classification should be assigned to a particular bargaining unit.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 90-day notice of sale/conveyance/assignment/transfer
rfp_requirements.description: In the event the Employer sells, conveys, assigns, or transfers its operation, the Employer will give the Union 90 days notice prior to the culmination of such event.

rfp_requirements.title: Advise new Employee of Union recognition at hire
rfp_requirements.description: At the time a new Employee subject to this Agreement is hired, the Employer shall advise the Employee that the Employer recognizes and is in contractual relations with the Union.

rfp_requirements.title: Afford Union officer opportunity to speak during orientation
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer shall afford a Union officer an opportunity to speak to the new Employee during orientation.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain existing Union membership as condition of employment
rfp_requirements.description: All Employees on the active payroll as of May 13, 1999, who are members of the Union, shall maintain their membership in the Union as a condition of continued employment.

rfp_requirements.title: Become Union member within 30 days of employment
rfp_requirements.description: All Employees on the active payroll shall become members of the Union no later than the 30th day following the beginning of such employment, and shall thereafter maintain membership as a condition of continued employment.

rfp_requirements.title: No deduction obligation if insufficient wages
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer shall not be obliged to make dues deductions of any kind from any Employee who, during any dues month, shall have failed to receive sufficient wages to equal the dues deduction.

rfp_requirements.title: Remit monthly dues with Employee list
rfp_requirements.description: Each month, the Employer shall remit to the Union all dues deductions for the preceding month together with a list of all Employees from whom dues have been deducted.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide advance notice of Union representative visits
rfp_requirements.description: Union representatives shall provide advance notice to the Labor Relations Manager or designee of intent to visit an Employer location and arrange a mutually convenient time.

rfp_requirements.title: Advise Station Manager before entering work area
rfp_requirements.description: Where the Union representative finds it necessary to enter a work area, he/she shall first advise the Station Manager or designee in person.

rfp_requirements.title: Local 518 President/VP designates investigation representative
rfp_requirements.description: Subject to Article XXXV, paragraph 1, the Local 518 President/Vice-President or designee shall be solely responsible for designating the Local 518 representative to conduct a disciplinary or grievance investigation.

rfp_requirements.title: Copy Employer on Union-related e-mails
rfp_requirements.description: A Union representative shall have access to receive Union-related e-mails at all stations, provided the Employer is copied on all such e-mails.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit swing person to two contiguous lanes
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer agrees to limit use of a swing person to situations where there are two contiguous lanes with unobstructed views for the swing person between them.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer overtime by seniority regardless of classification when >4 inspectors/lane
rfp_requirements.description: If management requires more than 4 inspectors per lane, overtime must be offered to all station personnel based on seniority regardless of classification, on rotational basis.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow Saturday early release based on station needs
rfp_requirements.description: Employees may volunteer for early release from Saturday shift and manager may release based on station needs; pay is for time worked.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer overtime to Material Handlers/Tech Specialists by seniority rotation
rfp_requirements.description: Material Handler classifications and Technical Specialists must be offered available overtime in seniority order on a rotational basis; if insufficient volunteers, least senior employee must accept on rotational basis unless finding a replacement.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer ERT overtime station-first then region by seniority
rfp_requirements.description: Equipment Repair Technicians overtime must first be offered to the employee normally assigned to the station; then to other regional employees in seniority order on rotational basis; if insufficient volunteers, least senior station employee must accept unless finding replacement.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer Lane Tech overtime by combined seniority rotation
rfp_requirements.description: Senior Lane Technicians and Lane Technicians must be offered available overtime including Saturdays in seniority order of combined classifications on rotational basis, first at station then surrounding stations; then Associate Lane Technicians and other Lane Tech unit employees.

rfp_requirements.title: Mandatory acceptance of Lane Tech overtime by least senior including part-time
rfp_requirements.description: For Lane Technician overtime, if insufficient numbers accept offers, the least senior employee in those classifications (including part-time employees) shall be obligated to accept the overtime assignment on a rotational basis unless finding another employee to take his/her place.

rfp_requirements.title: Break seniority ties per order of preference
rfp_requirements.description: If a seniority tie must be broken, it shall be broken in order: (1) disabled veteran status, (2) veteran status, (3) lottery conducted by Employer and witnessed by impartial Union representative.

rfp_requirements.title: Commence seniority after probation, retroactive to hire date
rfp_requirements.description: An Employee's seniority shall commence after completion of probation and be retroactive to the date of most recent hire; returning Employees within 1 month of resignation in good standing retain original date.

rfp_requirements.title: Accrue seniority during authorized leave up to 1 year
rfp_requirements.description: Seniority continues to accrue during continuous authorized leave of absence up to 1 year (including FMLA/NJFLA), provided the Employee returns immediately upon expiration and the position remains available; also accrues during layoff up to 1 year or length of employment, whichever is less.

rfp_requirements.title: Employee must notify Employer of current address
rfp_requirements.description: Employees are responsible for notifying the Employer of their current address.

rfp_requirements.title: Return within 7 days of recall notice within 30-mile radius
rfp_requirements.description: Seniority is lost if laid off 12 months or if the employee fails to return to work within 7 days of a return to work notice to a station within a 30 mile radius of the home station, whichever is earlier.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply seniority by location for layoffs, recalls, vacations
rfp_requirements.description: Bargaining unit seniority must be applied by location in layoffs and recalls and for scheduling of vacations.

rfp_requirements.title: Lay off least senior employee first
rfp_requirements.description: The employee at the location with the least bargaining unit seniority must be laid off first.

rfp_requirements.title: Layoff procedural steps do not apply in emergencies/acts of God/State-directed situations
rfp_requirements.description: The pre-layoff procedural requirements (30-day notice, written notification to Union, 7-day meeting period) do not apply in emergencies, acts of God, or under operational situations directed by the State of New Jersey.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 30-day layoff notice or pay in lieu
rfp_requirements.description: Prior to layoff (except in emergencies, acts of God, or State-directed situations), the Employer must give the Union and affected employees 30 days notice, or 30 days pay in lieu.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide written notice with employee details
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer must notify the Union in writing of all employees affected, their dates of hire, job classification, and bargaining unit seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Lay off probationary employees first
rfp_requirements.description: Probationary employees must be laid off first without regard to their individual period of employment; non-probationary employees are laid off next based on seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Set seniority date upon layoff/classification elimination
rfp_requirements.description: For Technical Specialists, Material Handlers Group, or Equipment Repair Technicians, upon layoff or classification elimination, seniority date is the start date of obtaining the current classification.

rfp_requirements.title: Recall employees in reverse order of layoff by seniority
rfp_requirements.description: When a vacancy occurs, laid-off employees must be recalled per bargaining unit seniority in the reverse order they were laid off from their station; if not fillable at the station, vacancy is offered statewide by seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Remit lump-sum payments to employees
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer must remit to each employee a check in the specified amounts (2014 and 2015: $1,000 Full-Time; $500 Part-Time), less applicable withholdings.

rfp_requirements.title: Make payments on first full pay period in January
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer will make the payments on the first full pay period in January 2014 and January 2015; employees on approved medical leave receive payment upon return to active status.

rfp_requirements.title: Set regular workweek for Lane Technicians
rfp_requirements.description: Regular workweek for full-time Senior Lane Technicians, Lane Technicians, and full-time Associate Lane Technicians must be 8 hours/day, 5 days/week, Monday through Friday.

rfp_requirements.title: Guarantee 40 hours of work Monday through Friday
rfp_requirements.description: All employees, except part-time Associate Lane Technicians, must be guaranteed 40 hours of work Monday through Friday.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Saturday hours for Technical/Material/ERT
rfp_requirements.description: For Saturday, regular hours for Technical Specialists, Material Handler classifications, and Equipment Repair Technicians must be between 6:00 AM and 12:00 PM as determined by management and subject to State of NJ restrictions.

rfp_requirements.title: Take precautions during excessive heat or cold
rfp_requirements.description: During hours of excessive heat or cold, the Employer must take necessary precautions to protect employee health and safety, including extended breaks and consolidating operations. Anemometers shall remain in current locations.

rfp_requirements.title: Start full-time lunch breaks after 11:00 a.m.
rfp_requirements.description: Lunch breaks for full-time employees must start after 11:00 a.m.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide unpaid lunch and paid breaks to Lane Technicians
rfp_requirements.description: Senior Lane Technicians, Lane Technicians, and full-time Associate Lane Technicians must receive a one-hour unpaid lunch and four 15-minute paid breaks distributed two per half-day, plus any additional paid breaks at management discretion.

rfp_requirements.title: Part-Time Associate Lane Technician workweek governed by Article XXV
rfp_requirements.description: The regular workweek for all Part-Time Associate Lane Technicians is subject to the provisions set forth in Article XXV.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibit use of Part-Time to prevent full-time overtime
rfp_requirements.description: Part-Time Associate Lane Technicians may not be used to prevent full-time employees from working overtime.

rfp_requirements.title: Charge partial-day sick leave on hourly basis
rfp_requirements.description: Utilization of sick leave for less than a full workday shall be on an hourly basis: one hour charged for each hour or portion taken off.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow FMLA vacation substitution for exhausted sick leave
rfp_requirements.description: Employees on approved FMLA leave who have exhausted sick leave may elect, at their discretion, to use unused vacation days during the leave.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply sick leave provisions to all Monday–Saturday shifts
rfp_requirements.description: Sick leave provisions apply to all assigned shifts Monday through Saturday regardless of whether drafted or volunteered.

rfp_requirements.title: Charge sick leave for first day of absence
rfp_requirements.description: Except for employees using intermittent FMLA leave, employees will be charged sick leave for the first day of any absence.

rfp_requirements.title: Cap special leave hours
rfp_requirements.description: Special leave shall not be granted or credited for more than 8 hours in a day or 40 hours in a week.

rfp_requirements.title: Grant bereavement leave up to 24 hours
rfp_requirements.description: Bereavement leave shall be granted with pay to regular Employees due to death of an immediate family member, up to a maximum of 24 hours per bereavement.

rfp_requirements.title: Negotiate transfer provision if Technical Specialists or Material Handlers split locations
rfp_requirements.description: If Technical Specialists or Material Handlers are divided into two locations, the Employer and Union agree to negotiate a transfer provision.

rfp_requirements.title: Continue probation period at new location after transfer
rfp_requirements.description: Employees serving probation may transfer if Article provisions are met; probation period will not change but Employee continues probation at new location.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete probationary period before transfer eligibility
rfp_requirements.description: An Employee must have completed the probationary period per Article V to be eligible to transfer to an equivalent or lesser position at another station with a vacancy.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete transfer preference list
rfp_requirements.description: Employees wishing to transfer may indicate desired position and list up to three locations by completing a transfer preference list maintained by Company Human Resources.

rfp_requirements.title: Only new listed transfer preferences receive new date
rfp_requirements.description: Employees may update their transfer preference list at any time, but only new listed preferences will be assigned a new date.

rfp_requirements.title: Fill vacant positions when no preference stated
rfp_requirements.description: If no qualified Employee stated preference, position filled by any volunteer responding to posting, then by new hire from outside.

rfp_requirements.title: Exclude non-bargaining unit promotions from transfer provisions
rfp_requirements.description: The transfer provisions of Article XXXI shall not apply to promotions to fill vacant non-bargaining unit positions.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay 10% differential and travel pay for temporary transfer assignments
rfp_requirements.description: Employee assigned to fill temporary vacancy from another location shall receive 10% pay differential and travel pay, provided station resources including Part-Time Employees are exhausted.

rfp_requirements.title: Freeze Vehicle Inspector transfer lists until recall list exhausted
rfp_requirements.description: All Vehicle Inspector transfer lists are frozen until the recall list is exhausted.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide and replace required tools
rfp_requirements.description: Employer shall provide and replace all tools required; Employee is responsible for safekeeping and reasonable care of those tools.

rfp_requirements.title: Account for swapped/transferred inventory parts
rfp_requirements.description: ERTs may swap/transfer parts between one another; Employee is responsible to ensure inventory is properly accounted for with required paperwork completed.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide up to 220 days of paid Union leave
rfp_requirements.description: Employer agrees to provide up to 220 days of paid leave to Union delegates/officers/representatives for Union activities such as conventions, contract negotiations, and meetings.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not carry over unused Union paid leave
rfp_requirements.description: Any unused Union release days cannot be carried over to the following year and cannot be combined with other paid leave.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow advance of Union release days
rfp_requirements.description: If Union release time is exhausted during the contract year, the Union may ask Employer to advance Union release days from the upcoming contract year, which shall not be unreasonably denied; advanced days deducted from following year.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 45-day notice for vacation seniority conflict resolution
rfp_requirements.description: Vacation scheduling conflicts among Employees who have provided 45 days notice shall be resolved within the station on the basis of bargaining unit seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Grant vacation on first-come, first-serve basis
rfp_requirements.description: Employer may deny vacation requests based on business demands but not unreasonably; requests granted first-come, first-serve based on submission date.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide vacation accrual for under 1 year service
rfp_requirements.description: Employees with less than one year of service earn one vacation day for each two-month period of service.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 15 vacation days for 1–4 years service
rfp_requirements.description: Employees with one through end of fourth year of service receive 15 vacation days.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 20 vacation days for 5–11 years service
rfp_requirements.description: Employees with 5 through end of 11th year of service receive 20 vacation days.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 25 vacation days for 12+ years service
rfp_requirements.description: Employees with 12 or more years of service receive 25 vacation days.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 15 days notice for 6+ vacation days
rfp_requirements.description: Employees requesting 6 or more vacation days must provide 15 days notice.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 10 days notice for 3–5 vacation days
rfp_requirements.description: Employees requesting 3 to 5 vacation days must provide 10 days notice.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 24-hour notice for 1–2 vacation days
rfp_requirements.description: Employees requesting 1 to 2 vacation days must provide 24 hours notice.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay accrued vacation to estate upon death
rfp_requirements.description: If an Employee dies having accrued vacation credits, the accrued vacation time shall be paid to his estate.

rfp_requirements.title: Minimum Two Inspectors Per Lane Before 10:30 a.m.
rfp_requirements.description: Before 10:30 a.m. on Saturday, the Employer may not have fewer than two Employees inspecting vehicles in a single lane.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay to Next Half-Hour After Noon on Saturday
rfp_requirements.description: Employees who finish inspecting vehicles after 12:00 p.m. shall be paid to the next one-half hour, except those who volunteer to leave early.

rfp_requirements.title: Turn Away Vehicles Without Ticket by Closing
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer will turn away vehicles that have not pulled a ticket by closing time, unless directed otherwise by the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Publicly Disavow Prohibited Employee Action
rfp_requirements.description: The Union shall publicly disavow such action by the Employees.

rfp_requirements.title: Advise Employer in Writing of Non-Sanction
rfp_requirements.description: The Union shall advise the Employer in writing that the action was not called or sanctioned by the Union.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify Employees of Union Disapproval
rfp_requirements.description: The Union shall notify Employees of its disapproval of the action and instruct them to cease and return to work immediately.

rfp_requirements.title: Post Disapproval Notices on Union Bulletin Boards
rfp_requirements.description: The Union shall post notices on Union Bulletin Boards stating its disapproval and instructing Employees to return to work immediately.

rfp_requirements.title: Union Shall Take No Action Undermining Disavowal Statement
rfp_requirements.description: After delivery of the disavowal statement to the Company, the Union will take no action which in any way undermines it.

rfp_requirements.title: Employer Failure to Answer Not Deemed Acquiescence
rfp_requirements.description: Failure on the part of the Employer to answer a grievance at any step shall not be deemed acquiescence thereto, but shall entitle the Union to proceed to the next step.

rfp_requirements.title: Discharge/Suspension Grievance May Begin at Step 2
rfp_requirements.description: Notwithstanding the standard procedure, a grievance concerning a discharge or suspension may be presented initially at Step 2, within the time limit specified in Step 1.

rfp_requirements.title: Employer May Present Grievance Initially at Step 2
rfp_requirements.description: Without waiving its statutory rights, a grievance on behalf of the Employer may be presented initially at Step 2 by written notice addressed to the Union at its offices.
